sources.title: ReDimNet2: Scaling Speaker Verification via Time-Pooled Dimension Reshaping
sources.snippet: Abstract We present ReDimNet2, an improved neural network architecture for extracting utterance-level speaker representations that builds upon the ReDimNet dimension-reshaping framework. The key modification in ReDimNet2 is the introduction of pooling over the time dimension within the 1D processing pathway.
